# rms_role (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Role for access control.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_role" "admin" {
  title          = "Administrator"
  description    = "Full access role"
  company_id     = 123456
  permission_ids = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
}

resource "rms_role" "viewer" {
  title          = "Viewer"
  description    = "Read-only access"
  company_id     = 123456
  permission_ids = [1]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID this role belongs to.
- `permission_ids` (Set of Number) List of permission IDs assigned to this role.
- `title` (String) Title of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the role.
